title: Spiced Pumpkin Steel-Cut Oatmeal
changes_from_base: Warm spices are toasted in the pan, then brown sugar and pumpkin purée go in with milk and steel-cut oats, which simmer until tender; warm apple sauce and chopped apple are offered on top.
summary: Warming pumpkin pie spices permeate creamy steel-cut oats in this harvest-ready porridge, finished with optional apple and sauce for brightness.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast spices
steps.text: In a large saucepan over low heat toast ¼ tsp allspice, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ½ tsp cinnamon and ⅛ tsp ginger about 2 min, stirring, until fragrant.

steps.title: Add pumpkin
steps.text: Stir in 50 g light brown sugar, then 245 g tinned pumpkin purée.

steps.title: Liquid
steps.text: Add 1080 ml semi-skimmed milk or water and raise the heat to bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Oats
steps.text: Stir in 265 g steel-cut oats and simmer over medium heat 25-30 min, stirring often, until tender but not mushy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in ¾ tsp salt, then ladle into bowls and top each with a spoonful of warmed apple sauce (optional) and chopped eating apple (optional).

tips: Toast spices in the dry pan to awaken their aromatics before adding other ingredients.
Stir the porridge regularly toward the end of cooking so the pumpkin doesn't catch on the bottom.
Choose either apple sauce or fresh apple, or both, depending on texture preference.
storage: Serve warm; leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days and reheat gently over low heat or in the microwave with a splash of milk or water. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
